Its combat capabilities are as impressive as its extravagant design.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 38 |durability = 60 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Royal Bow}} Royal Bows are [[Bow]]s that [[King Rhoam]] used to gift to the most talented archers in [[Hyrule]]. Both their combat ability and design are noted to be impressive. They are commonly found in [[Treasure Chest]]s or in use by high-tier [[Enemy|Enemies]] on the [[Tabantha Frontier]] and in the [[Hebra Mountains]]. When scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]], the following [[amiibo]] have a chance to spawn a Treasure Chest containing a Royal Bow: * {{SSB}} Series [[Zelda]] amiibo * {{BotW}} Series [[Link]] (Archer) amiibo Due to their metallic composition, Royal Bows will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are outdoors during a [[Thunderstorm]]. They will also sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] Rune. Finally, they will not burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Royal Bows belong to the [[Royal Gear]] equipment archetype, which is associated with the [[Royal Family of Hyrule]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 168}} {{BotW Bow Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Bow_036" |Life = 60 |Power = 38 |Range = 20.0 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 8 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 7 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 14 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 9 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 15 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 15 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 28 |PoweredSharpAddSpreadFire = false |PoweredSharpAddZoomRapid = false |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMin = 1.1 |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMax = 1.3 |ArrowName = "" |IsLeadShot = false |LeadShotNum = 0 |LeadShotAng = 45.0 |IsRapidFire = false |RapidFireNum = 0 |ArrowGravity = -9.8 |ArrowChargeRate = 1.0 |ArrowReloadRate = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Royal Bow}} {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Royal Bow Concept Artwork.png|Concept artwork of a Royal Bow ==See Also== {{See Also| * Royal Gear * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Bows, Royal Gear, Weapons |items= BotW, TotK }}
